final: SELECT AVG(category_avg_relative_overspend) AS average_category_relative_overspend, AVG(line_count) AS average_line_count, AVG(line_count - overall_avg_line_count) AS average_excess_line_count FROM (SELECT category, AVG(1.0 * (spent - amount) / amount) AS category_avg_relative_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count, (SELECT AVG(category_line_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category)) AS overall_avg_line_count FROM budget WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount <> 0 GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(category_line_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category)))
